page: Microsoft Azure F8ads_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V. It features an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor based on the x86_64 architecture, delivering 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs running at up to 4.5 GHz with a single thread per core. The configuration is provisioned with 32.0 GB of system memory, matching a 4.0 GB per core ratio, and includes 944 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD local storage. It contains no dedicated GPUs and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The processor supports advanced vector instructions including AVX-512 extensions (f, vnni, and bf16) alongside hardware encryption acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the top 10% for single-core execution, achieving 3623.48 in stress-ng single-core tests, 39.48 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression, and 17.87 GB/sec in single-threaded bzip3 decompression. Small-model LLM text generation (135M) also scores in the top tier at 358.88 tokens per second. Multi-core compute throughput aligns with the median tier, showing 29294.17 in stress-ng multi-core and 24323.24 on the PassMark CPU suite. Memory operations register 62.38 GB/sec read and 38.95 GB/sec write throughput on uncached 256 MB blocks, supporting steady transaction rates of 24.34 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks.

The 1:1 physical-to-virtual core allocation provides predictable compute capacity without thread contention. The integration of 944 GB of local NVMe storage provides fast temporary disk I/O, reducing reliance on remote disk volumes for scratch workloads. This hardware profile makes the instance suitable for continuous integration pipelines, batch data compression, static web serving, memory-cached key-value stores, and CPU-based inference workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure F8ads_v7 is a compute-focused instance powered by an 8-core AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked at 4.5 GHz with a 1:1 physical core-to-vCPU ratio. It provides 32.0 GB of RAM alongside 944 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage, operating without dedicated GPUs. In benchmarking evaluations, the instance demonstrates top-tier single-core compute performance, highlighted by strong results in stress-ng single-core runs, single-threaded gzip compression, and lightweight LLM text generation. Multi-threaded processing, memory throughput, and database operations place steadily within the median tier. With dedicated core execution, advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, and high-speed local storage, the F8ads_v7 is structured for workloads such as build systems, compression tasks, key-value data stores, and CPU-driven batch processing.
